announcements.headline: KBC Group: Third-quarter result of 1 142 million euros
announcements.insight: KBC Group reports a third-quarter result of 1,142 million euros. This follows a second-quarter result of 1,152 million euros in August.

announcements.headline: KBC Group: KBC’s capital remains well above the minimum capital requirements
announcements.insight: KBC Group confirms its capital remains well above minimum requirements. This follows the appointment of a new CIO and the release of second-quarter results.

announcements.headline: KBC Group: Second-quarter result of 1 152 million euros
announcements.insight: KBC Group reports a second-quarter result of 1 152 million euros. This follows the June appointment of Kris Vervaet as Group CIO.

announcements.headline: KBC Group: KBC appoints Kris Vervaet as Group CIO
announcements.insight: KBC Group appoints Kris Vervaet as Group CIO. This board change may influence investment strategy and risk management oversight.
